description: Returns the negative binomial distribution, the probability that there will be the specified number of failures before the last success, with the specified probability of a success.

params.description: The probability of a success; a number between 0 and 1.
params.name: arg3

params.description: A logical value (**true** or **false**) that determines the function form.If it is **true**, the function returns the cumulative distribution function.If it is **false**, the function returns the probability density function.
params.name: arg4

signature: NEGBINOM_DIST(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4: ApiRange | ApiName | boolean): number
